wiki.title: Greta Neubauer
wiki.extract: Gretchen Stephens "Greta" Neubauer ( NOO-bow-ər; born September 13, 1991) is an American Democratic politician from Racine, Wisconsin. She is the minority leader in the Wisconsin State Assembly, since January 2022, and has been a member of the Assembly since 2018, representing Wisconsin's 66th Assembly district.
